name: Battle Instinct
description: Aggression with nowhere left to go but into the next swing.

name: Iron Skin
description: Enough hits taken that the flinch stopped coming.

name: Hardy Constitution
description: A body built to endure — nothing magical about it, just resilience that doesn't quit.

name: Deep Reserves
description: Holds more magic in reserve than most ever learn how to reach for.

name: Unshaken Resolve
description: A mind trained not to let the dark get the better of it.

name: Evasive Instinct
description: A half-step sideways that's already happened by the time the blow arrives.

name: Leeching Will
description: A stubborn will that leeches a little life back from every wound it deals.

name: Arcane Aptitude
description: A natural aptitude for channeling magic, drawn on with every spell cast.

name: Predator's Edge
description: Finds the gap in a guard before the enemy knows it's open.

name: Bulwark Stance
description: A stance drilled until it's second nature — nothing gets through easily.

name: Second Wind
description: The talent for finding one more reserve of strength when it matters most.

name: Bloodletting
description: A brutal technique that turns every wound dealt into strength regained.

name: Featherstep Training
description: Footwork most fighters never bother to learn, until it's the only reason they're still standing.

name: Restless Vigor
description: An energy that never settles, always pushing the body to move first.

name: Executioner's Instinct
description: Knows exactly where the killing blow lands, and how to recover from delivering it.

name: Thunderous Aura
description: An aura that occasionally lashes out on its own, independent of any weapon.

name: Vampiric Discipline
description: A discipline where the fight itself has started feeding it back.

name: Phantom Reflexes
description: The body moves before the mind's finished deciding to.

name: Battle Scholar
description: Draws a lesson from every fight, learning faster than the rest of the party.

name: Undying Will
description: Sends every blow back on whoever dealt it, and has more left in reserve to survive what follows.

name: Reaper's Instinct
description: Every kill closes the wounds already taken — and leaves this fighter feeding on whatever's left of the fight.

name: Eye of the Storm
description: The stillness at the center of the storm — impossible to look away from, while the chaos around it strikes on its own.

name: Grandmaster's Focus
description: Nothing in a fight goes to waste anymore — not the cooldown between strikes, not the lesson buried in losing one.

name: Unerring Will
description: A conviction so absolute that fear itself can't shake the outcome — some strikes and afflictions simply cannot be denied.
